def VTask.subtypePreimage : {α : Sort u_1} -> {β : Sort u_4} -> (p : α → Prop) -> [DecidablePred p] -> (x₀ : { a // p a } → β) -> { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a // ¬p a } → β) := fun α β p hp x₀ => by
  have h_main : { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a // ¬p a } → β) := by
    constructor
    · -- Forward direction: { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } → ({ a // ¬p a } → β)
      intro x
      have h₁ : x.1 ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := x.2
      -- Define y : { a // ¬p a } → β by y ⟨a, ha⟩ = x a
      have h₂ : x.1 ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := x.2
      refine' ⟨fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => x.1 a, _⟩
      -- Verify that y is well-defined and satisfies the required properties
      <;> simp_all [Subtype.ext_iff]
      <;> aesop
    · -- Backward direction: ({ a // ¬p a } → β) → { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ }
      intro y
      have h₁ : ∀ (a : α), ¬p a → y ⟨a, by tauto⟩ = y ⟨a, by tauto⟩ := by simp
      -- Define x : α → β by x a = if p a then x₀ ⟨a, _⟩ else y ⟨a, _⟩
      refine' ⟨fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by tauto⟩, _⟩
      -- Verify that x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀
      have h₂ : (fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by tauto⟩) ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := by
        ext ⟨a, ha⟩
        have h₃ : p a := ha
        have h₄ : (if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by tauto⟩) = x₀ ⟨a, ha⟩ := by
          simp [h₃]
        simp [h₄]
        <;> aesop
      exact h₂
  exact h_main
